description: This file implements a React component for a document viewer page, which allows users to browse a library of documents, select a document, and view it either as a PDF or as an embedded iframe. It manages document data fetching, PDF rendering via PDF.js, signed URL handling, and user interactions for navigation, zoom, and opening documents in new tabs.

methods.name: useQueryParam
methods.description: Custom hook to extract query parameters from URL search string.

methods.name: inferIsPdf
methods.description: Infers whether the given document is a PDF based on mime type or filename extension.

methods.name: openSignedUrlInline
methods.description: Fetches a signed URL, converts it to a blob URL for inline display, with fallback to direct URL opening if fetch fails.

methods.name: ViewerPage
methods.description: Main React component for the document viewer page, supporting PDF rendering, embedded iframe, and document list management.
